blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Carlos Yulo stamped his golden mark on the gymnastics floor, winning Team Philippines’ first gold medal in the Asian Games 2026 on Thursday at Nagoya General Gymnasium. Five days after the Aichi-Nagoya Games officially began, Yulo finally delivered the gold medal for the country by ruling the floor exercise event–the first of his three apparatus finals. As the fourth performer, the two-time Olympic gold medalist set the standard with a clean routine that earned 14.666 points on a 5.7 difficulty.
